## Checklist

- [ ] The base branch is right: `develop` for `openctem`, `main` for every other repository.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No AI or tool attribution in commits or in this description.
- [ ] A `changelog.d/<slug>.md` fragment is added, if this repository has `changelog.d/` and the change is user visible.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, internal hostnames or private addresses.
- [ ] Every commit author has accepted the [Contributor License Agreement](https://docs.openctem.io/legal/cla/), or is a maintainer.
